published_evidence.exploitation_evidence: The incorrect calculation of the long0Fees, long1Fees and other variables used to calculate fees caused the transfer fee to always be zero.
published_evidence.fix_strategy_evidence: Calculate the actual values of long0Fees, long1Fees, and shortFees before calling transferFees().
published_evidence.root_cause_evidence: The calculation of variables like long0Fees and long1Fees is executed only after the transferFees() function call.
